title: Co-polymerized CMY colored polyurethane latex with high color strength and fastness for inkjet printing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10958-10965
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08440G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bin Liu, Jun Chen, Xibin He, Shuxu Chen, Junpei Li, Fucai Liu
Storage-stable CMY hue co-polyurethane colorant latex, developed by dye content exceeding 30%, can be printed with high precision, easy to achieve an overall color fixation rate > 95%, and exhibited excellent wet and dry rubbing fastness.
